criteria.stated_claim: numeral or claim-not-shown language, recorded verbatim
criteria.no_broll: <=2 scene cuts (ffmpeg scdet), PROBED not assumed

why: Four prior corpora scored CORRECT DECLINES as defects: REF-2 (already edited), the editorial_eng pair (no trigger at all), the frozen goldens (scenes testable on 0/12), and the component corpus (source carries its own B-roll — the model said so). A scene answers a claim the footage CANNOT show, so only a source with a claim and no cutaway can falsify 'the model will not emit a scene'.

sources.vibe:
Edit this video into a high-end, professional real estate social media video.

Keep my original voice and natural speaking style. Do not change the meaning of what I say.

Editing style:

* Fast-paced but elegant editing suitable for Instagram Reels, TikTok and YouTube Shorts.
* Remove long pauses, dead air, unnecessary breaths, mistakes and awkward gaps.
* Add subtle punch-in zooms (around 105%–115%) when I emphasize an important point.
* Use smooth zoom-outs or slight reframing when changing between topics.
* Add occasional subtle camera movement to make the footage feel dynamic, but avoid excessive effects.
* Use clean, modern transitions. Avoid flashy or cheesy transitions.

Audio:

* Clean and enhance my voice so it sounds crisp, clear and professional.
* Reduce background noise and room echo.
* Add subtle professional sound effects for important cuts, text appearances and transitions.
* Keep sound effects low enough that they never overpower my voice.
* Add subtle whoosh/click/pop sounds only where they feel natural.
* Use light background music if appropriate, keeping it very low under my voice.

On-screen text:

* Add clean, modern captions synchronized precisely with my speech.
* Highlight important keywords using a contrasting accent color.
* Use short phrases instead of displaying full sentences whenever possible.
* Make the typography premium, minimal and easy to read on a phone.
* Add important numbers, prices, percentages, locations and investment terms as larger animated text when mentioned.
* Use smooth text animations such as fade, slide or subtle scale.
* Keep text away from my face.

Visual emphasis:

* When I mention a location, price, ROI, payment plan, developer or important investment point, emphasize it visually with animated text.
* Use subtle icons or minimal graphic elements when they improve understanding.
* If the video contains property images, maps or screenshots, add smooth zooms and pans to them.
* Use B-roll or visual overlays only when they genuinely support what I am saying.

Color and look:

* Give the footage a premium real-estate look.
* Improve exposure, contrast, sharpness and skin tones naturally.
* Keep skin tones realistic.
* Use a sophisticated cinematic color grade without making the footage overly dark or oversaturated.

Overall:
The final video should feel like it was edited by a professional Dubai luxury real-estate content editor.

Prioritize:

1. Strong hook in the first 2–3 seconds.
2. High viewer retention.
3. Clear voice.
4. Dynamic but natural cuts.
5. Professional animated captions.
6. Subtle zooms and sound effects.
7. Premium real-estate branding.
8. No unnecessary effects or distracting animations.

Make the final result polished, modern, confident and suitable for a Dubai real estate broker building a personal brand.
